A cheerful, upbeat, and simple tune.
A slower and more sinister track.
Relatively peaceful and relaxing, though in a minor key.
A whimsical track with an almost robotic tone.
Loud and frantic battle music, with the scratching sounds at the beginning sounding like a siren.
A serene, solemn tune, but short and hooking.
An exotic, relaxed tune, it has a heavy emphasis on percussion.
Its melody somewhat resembles the Overworld Day track but altered and slowed to sound much darker and more menacing.
It has a very happy, heavenly tone and makes use of instruments related to this idea, especially the harp and glockenspiel. It shares a lot of its melody with Overworld Day.
This track is a combination of Corruption and Underground tracks, with a depressing and dark tone.

column3: This track is a combination of the Hallow and Underground tracks. It shares the heavenly tone of the Hallow track, but with a faster-paced, electronic tune.
It is a very hectic, frantic tune, and gives the feel of a chase, fear and horror, especially at the beginning.
It is much slower and less intense than the other boss fights, the slowest track in the soundtrack, giving it a more menacing and mechanical tone.
A relaxed, somewhat slow-paced theme with a distinct, cold, and crystalline feel.
A quick and carefree theme that makes use of many airy synths and shares some of its instruments with the Overworld Day theme. Contains a motif of Underground.
An unnerving, dark, and unsettling theme with a faster pace than that of the Corruption. Its main melody comes near the end of the track.
Fast paced without being particularly dark or menacing.
A cheerful, upbeat tune similar to the Overworld Day theme, but with a more complex composition.
It gives the effect of a peaceful and calming theme, slower and less upbeat than others.
A calm, mysterious, and wintery theme slightly reminiscent of the Alt Underground theme.
It is a simple, quiet theme inspired by ancient Egyptian music as commonly portrayed in other video games and films.
It is a tranquil theme with a somewhat slower pace than other daytime themes.
A sinister, dark theme that makes use of various instruments to evoke a sound akin to the echoes of a deep dungeon below.
It is a unique, mid-tempo track in a heavy metal style, featuring prominent use of electric guitars and incorporating melodies from the Jungle soundtrack. It is a nod to Cenx's favorite band, .
It is a frenetic, serious theme, which uses sounds resembling buzzes and hovering.
A mysterious and exotic-sounding theme, feeling like being in an ancient world.
It is dark with a varying pace, featuring an organ to give it a classic horror feel.
The sounds of rain pattering on the ground with slight hints of distant thunder.
An offbeat, exotic, and trippy piece. It also contains a Corruption motif past the middle of the track.
Spooky Halloween-themed music.
It has a different, less whimsical feel than the original Underground theme. It also contains a Boss 2 motif near the end of the song.
It vaguely resembles a Christmas song but is more upbeat and uses an electric guitar with a heavy distortion applied giving it a metal feel to the track.
A mix of the Underground and Crimson tracks.
A fast, abstract, and especially intense theme.
Somewhat reminiscent of the ' soundtrack.
A deep and menacing track, with an emphasis on harsh percussion.
A loud, daunting track.
A unique, intense track with a fast tempo. Reuses part of the The Towers and Space Night themes.
It somewhat vaguely resembles the Pumpkin Moon theme.
A tense theme that uses a synth to simulate wind (along with actual wind sounds) as well as a sitar to give a sort of Egyptian desert feeling. Some parts of Boss 5 and The Towers can be heard.

An intense theme, more orchestral than most other Terraria songs, which incorporates bits from the main theme of Dungeon Defenders as well as Terraria tracks Pirate Invasion, Title, Goblin Invasion, and Pumpkin Moon.
It has a slower and calmer feeling.
This track is more active and bouncier than its daytime counterpart. It has a happy, peaceful sounding tone.

A perky, cheerful, whimsical track, inspired by .<ref> </ref> It includes instruments such as a music box, castanets, and a tambourine, and is one of the few tracks in the game to not be in  , rather it is in .
The sounds of wind blowing past.
A soothing track with a slight resemblance to Overworld Day.
It starts quickly and then slows down to reveal a calm and enjoyable melody.
A bouncy, slightly silly-sounding track. It contains motifs of the Ocean Night and Underground themes.
This hardstyle remix by Xenon and DSniper of the Overworld Day theme was the winning track of Terraria's 2013 music contest.<ref> </ref>

A triumphant, powerful track. On game launch and in the 1.4 trailer it features a "whoom" intro sound before looping into the standard Journey's Beginning track. It is also the first track to be heard by a new player.
A triumphant, powerful track that lacks the "whoom" intro sound.
It sounds harsh and threatening, and has a slight resemblance to the Old One's Army and Sandstorm tracks.
A dark, depressing spin on the Town themes.
Significantly less whimsical than the surface Jungle track and sounds more threatening and melancholic.
It sounds very different from the day theme, with the main melody being a slow, ominous beat with an emphasis on deep drums.
It begins with a regal and celebratory style, before turning into something more sinister and methodical. It contains a motif of Jungle Night.

It begins as a fast, extremely intense track similar to Boss 2, before changing to a slower tune. The entire track has a very chaotic feel and sounds unlike anything else in Terraria. Uniquely, this track features a second loop with different composition, before completely looping.
A slow theme with bubbling sounds and a pirate-like feel, in stark contrast with the fast-paced and chaotic fight it accompanies.
Very similar to the Overworld Day theme, but is significantly more extravagant and jolly, like one is about to embark on an adventure. This also used to be the old tutorial theme.
An extended variation of the Title track, with more instruments and expression.
It begins as a slow, mysterious theme featuring strings and low tones, before it transitions into a rock-style theme, with guitars and heavy drums, similar to the Plantera track.
An atmospheric track with light piano sounds that brings the image of falling rain.
A celebratory, almost victoriously sounding track which features instruments like Irish flute for a fantasy feeling.

column2:

column3: It is an ominous, at times frantic track that gives a sense of impending danger.
A heroic-sounding track which features violin. Its internal name is "Music-Main Theme (Underground)" which suggests it was meant as a title screen track, which in turn fits with its grand intro.

It begins with dobro (or similarly sounding instrument) for a Wild West feeling, along with occasional heartbeats. It continues with Irish flute for a fantasy feeling, and ends with subtle female vocals.
An ambient-like track which incorporates pan flute music to produce the image of distant shores.
It resembles a more tranquil version of the regular Mushrooms track. Its internal name is "Music-Crystal Caves (Mushrooms)" which suggests it would also play in some Gemstone cave-like biome.
It is a melancholic and ritualistic-feeling track which features chanting and tribal-like drums.
An ambient track which subtly features "psychedelic" sounds for a sci-fi feeling and gradually grows to a heroic sound.
Dark, aggressive, and features harpsichord music for a "haunted house" feeling.
A calm and relaxing track which shifts between what resembles uplifting trance music and fantasy music.
It is a dark, undulating track which features downtempo rock music.
Resembles its Otherworldly surface counterpart, but is somewhat more aggressive.
A dark, ambient track which seems to feature some type of contrabass brass instrument for a "gloomy" feeling and eventually becomes almost psychedelic-sounding.
A brooding and increasingly frantic track.
It has a "crystalline" and rather ominous sound to it.
A sinister track that seems to involve different percussion instruments as well as a music box styled instrumentation to evoke a sense of sinister whimsy.

column3: A menacing, "rapid" track which gives a sense of running out of time.
Somewhat heroic-sounding, and features chanting as well as ample amounts of electric guitar.
Resembles The Towers track but has more chanting and feels even more dramatic, as is appropriate with the Moon Lord appearing after the Lunar Events.
A metal-like track with a sinister and somewhat gloomy feeling, appropriate for the fight against Plantera in the Underground Jungle.

A surprisingly tranquil track which seems to feature hurdy-gurdy music towards its end. The extended, enhanced version sold as part of the official Otherworld soundtrack is titled "Sky Guardian" (another name for the Wyvern) which suggests it was meant to play on Floating Islands or similar instead.

column3: It is a dramatic and at times also heroic-sounding track.
A track which features angelic, hymn-like female vocals followed by calm piano music. It is the only in-game Otherworld track longer than 2 minutes.
A heroic, celebratory track, fit for the theme heard just after beating the Moon Lord. It includes short bits from several other tracks.
Arranged by . It is an upbeat, electronic remix of "The E.F.S. Of Winter" from Don't Starve Together. E.F.S. stands for Epic Fight Song.
Ethereal, surreal, and yet calming track that bears a similarity to the Space tracks, fitting for the location the track plays in.
A rough, grungy track filled with crunchy instruments and percussion.
Grand and bouncy track with a swing tempo that expresses mediocrity in the king's difficulty.
A subdued, ominous, yet fast-paced track with a synthesized orchestra, percussion, and choir voices, similar to the Lunatic Cultist's own vocalizations.
A fast and frenetic barrage of staccato percussion and synth, emulating the sound of harsh, buzzing bugs.
An ominous and intense composition that creates the impression of emptiness, as if the player is being closely watched.
A dramatic metal track with Reese instruments.
A spacious, yet exhilarating spree of exotic noises and dissonance of synth and strings.
